## Same-origin service links from helper components

- Work OS `84c9929d-e38b-40b5-9bf7-46be1277cc10`; worktree
  `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-service-href`, base
  `12e9b08c`.
- Workers AI imagery succeeded on #314 (3 heroes generated and reviewed), but
  authoring rejected the candidate for `href={`/services/${service.slug}/`}`.
  The link came from a helper section component that receives the sealed
  `services` collection as a prop; the strict provenance check only traced the
  root Experience binding.
- The validator now accepts a map over a helper component's `services`
  parameter. A destructured `services` inside the root Experience keeps the
  strict path, so element mutation (`services[0].slug = ...`) and invented
  literals still fail. Mutation and provenance tests remain green.
- Two SEO-only author tests fail locally because their reference screenshots
  are now offloaded to R2, not because of this change.
